segments.an3.40:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an3.40:1.6: ‘na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
segments.an3.40:1.7: Na piṇḍapātahetu, na senāsanahetu, na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
segments.an3.40:1.8: Api ca khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
segments.an3.40:1.9: Appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti.
segments.an3.40:1.10: Ahañceva kho pana yādisake [yādisake vā (sī. pī. ka.)] kāme ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito tādisake vā [ca (ka.)] kāme pariyeseyyaṃ tato vā [ca (ka.)] pāpiṭṭhatare, na metaṃ patirūpan’ti.
segments.an3.40:1.12: ‘āraddhaṃ kho pana me vīriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggan’ti.
segments.an3.40:1.13: So attānaṃyeva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
segments.an3.40:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an3.40:2.3: ‘na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
segments.an3.40:2.4: Na piṇḍapātahetu, na senāsanahetu, na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
segments.an3.40:2.5: Api ca khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
segments.an3.40:2.6: Appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.an3.40:2.7: Ahañceva kho pana evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāmavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, byāpādavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, mahā kho panāyaṃ lokasannivāso.
segments.an3.40:2.8: Mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno.
segments.an3.40:2.9: Te dūratopi passanti, āsannāpi na dissanti, cetasāpi cittaṃ pajānanti [jānanti (ka.)].
segments.an3.40:2.11: ‘passatha, bho, imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehī’ti.
segments.an3.40:2.12: Devatāpi kho santi iddhimantiniyo dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduniyo.
segments.an3.40:2.13: Tā dūratopi passanti, āsannāpi na dissanti, cetasāpi cittaṃ jānanti.
segments.an3.40:2.15: ‘passatha, bho, imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehī’ti.
segments.an3.40:2.17: ‘āraddhaṃ kho pana me vīriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggan’ti.
segments.an3.40:2.18: So lokaṃyeva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
segments.an3.40:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an3.40:3.3: ‘na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
segments.an3.40:3.4: Na piṇḍapātahetu, na senāsanahetu, na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
segments.an3.40:3.5: Api ca khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
segments.an3.40:3.6: Appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti.
segments.an3.40:3.7: Svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
segments.an3.40:3.8: Santi kho pana me sabrahmacārī jānaṃ passaṃ viharanti.
segments.an3.40:3.9: Ahañceva kho pana evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajito samāno kusīto vihareyyaṃ pamatto, na metaṃ assa patirūpan’ti.
segments.an3.40:3.11: ‘āraddhaṃ kho pana me vīriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggan’ti.
segments.an3.40:3.12: So dhammaṃyeva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
segments.an3.40:4.3: Attā te purisa jānāti, saccaṃ vā yadi vā musā.
segments.an3.40:5.3: Yo santaṃ attani pāpaṃ, attānaṃ parigūhasi.
segments.an3.40:6.3: Tasmā hi attādhipateyyako ca [attādhipako sako care (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)],
segments.an3.40:8.1: Brahma ānanda sāriputto, nidānaṃ hatthakena ca;
segments.an3.40:8.3: Dūtā duve ca rājāno, sukhumālādhipateyyena cāti.

lines: Na iti bhavābhavahetūti iti bhavo, iti bhavoti evaṃ āyatiṃ, na tassa tassa sampattibhavassa hetu.
Yassa hi jāti antopaviṭṭhā, so jātiyā otiṇṇo nāma.
Passaddho kāyoti nāmakāyo ca karajakāyo ca passaddho vūpasantadaratho.
Samāhitaṃ cittanti ārammaṇe cittaṃ sammā āhitaṃ suṭṭhu ṭhapitaṃ.
Suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharatīti suddhaṃ nimmalaṃ katvā attānaṃ pariharati paṭijaggati, gopāyatīti attho.
Ayañca yāva arahattamaggā pariyāyena suddhamattānaṃ pariharati nāma, phalappattova pana nippariyāyena suddhamattānaṃ pariharati.
Jānaṃ passaṃ viharantīti taṃ dhammaṃ jānantā passantā viharanti.
Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi ādhipateyyānīti ettāvatā tīṇi ādhipateyyāni lokiyalokuttaramissakāni kathitāni.
Attā te purisa jānāti, saccaṃ vā yadi vā musāti yaṃ tvaṃ karosi, taṃ yadi vā yathāsabhāvaṃ yadi vā no yathāsabhāvanti tava attāva jānāti.
Iminā ca kāraṇena veditabbaṃ “pāpakammaṃ karontassa loke paṭicchannaṭṭhānaṃ nāma natthī”ti.
Attānaṃ parigūhasīti yathā me attāpi na jānāti, evaṃ naṃ parigūhāmīti vāyamasi.
Yo ca phusī jātikkhayaṃ padhānavāti yo jhāyī padhānavā māraṃ abhibhavitvā jātikkhayaṃ arahattaṃ phusi.
Lokavidūti tayo loke vidite pākaṭe katvā ṭhito.
Sabbesu dhammesu atammayo munīti sabbe tebhūmakadhamme taṇhāsaṅkhātāya tammayatāya abhāvena atammayo khīṇāsavamuni kadāci katthaci na hīyati na parihīyatīti vuttaṃ hotīti.

lines: Dasame abhibhavitvā pavattanaṭṭhena adhipati yaṃ kiñci jeṭṭhakaṃ na kārakaṃ attānaṃ adhipatīti katvā attā eva adhipati, tato āgataṃ attādhipateyyaṃ.
So ca kho iddhividhādiguṇavisesayutto adhippeto adhipatibhāvassa adhippetattā.
Iti bhavoti evaṃ sampattibhavo, tattha evaṃ abhivuddhīti.
Sampattibhavassa hetūti taṃtaṃsampattibhavassa tattha ca abhivuddhiyā hetu.
